# A vanId in the body wins over every other criterion

**Claim.** When the body carries a vanId, the rest of the criteria are not used to search — they are not even checked for agreement. A name that belongs to nobody still matches, so a caller who sends a stale vanId alongside fresh details gets the stale record back.

Applies to: `~1people~1find/post`

## Observed exchange

_One person to aim at._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Harriet",
  "lastName": "Kowalski-{scope}",
  "dateOfBirth": "1975-03-14",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "harriet.kowalski-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ],
  "phones": [
    {
      "phoneNumber": "9075554242"
    }
  ],
  "addresses": [
    {
      "addressLine1": "742 Evergreen Terrace",
      "city": "Springfield",
      "stateOrProvince": "AK",
      "zipOrPostalCode": "99501"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Ask for that vanId while giving a name that matches no record at all. The contradiction is ignored: the vanId decides the answer by itself._

```http
POST /people/find

{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "firstName": "Desmond",
  "lastName": "Pemberton-{scope}"
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```
